description: This file is a shell script used for various external toolchain tasks, such as testing compiler features, finding libraries and binaries, wrapping compiler tools, and generating configuration files for cross-compilation toolchains. It defines functions to probe compilers and libc types, handle command-line arguments for different operations, and automate parts of toolchain setup and validation.

methods.name: test_c
methods.description: Tests compilation of C code with the current compiler.

methods.name: test_cxx
methods.description: Tests compilation of C++ code with the current compiler.

methods.name: test_softfloat
methods.description: Checks if the compiler supports soft floating point.

methods.name: test_uclibc
methods.description: Determines if the libc is uClibc by inspecting sysroot libraries.

methods.name: test_feature
methods.description: Tests support for a specified feature such as 'c', 'c++', 'softfloat', or libc features.

methods.name: find_libs
methods.description: Finds shared libraries matching specified patterns based on library specs.

methods.name: find_bins
methods.description: Finds executable binaries matching specified patterns based on bin specs.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Generates a .config file for a specific target based on detected compiler features.

methods.name: probe_cc
methods.description: Probes and sets the C compiler path if not already set.

methods.name: probe_cxx
methods.description: Probes and sets the C++ compiler path if not already set.

methods.name: probe_cpp
methods.description: Probes and sets the C preprocessor path if not already set.

methods.name: probe_libc
methods.description: Detects and sets the libc type used in the toolchain.
